name: MUZIKAZ Live Firing Range
label: Live multiplayer tournament range
description: Permanent shared firing range with server-scored multiplayer tournaments, timed challenges, moving targets, lane selection, adjustable scopes and a live competition board. Practice, compete or spectate from the safe firing-line lobby.

name: Firing Range — Force Training
label: Classic five-lane qualification range
description: Original five-point Force Training course with protected full-length booths, layered scoring plates, reactive silhouettes, timed qualification and shared practice. Enhanced materials, shot impacts and recoil.

name: MUZIKAZ Basketball Arena
label: Live basketball stadium
description: Permanent public basketball stadium: regulation hardwood court, glass-backboard hoops, live scoreboard, team jerseys and shared matches. Join a team to play, or watch from the spectator benches and accessible stands.

name: Sheep Base
label: Base level
description: Open Sheep Base combat environment scaled to a full playable arena.

name: Studio Ridge Interior

name: Studio Ridge Outdoors
label: Outdoor map

name: Crew Plaza Outdoors
label: Outdoor map
description: Playable Crew Plaza exterior map sized as a full encounter space.

name: Jail Cells
label: Challenge level

name: MUZIKAZ Full House
label: Combined map
description: Main and upper-floor MUZIKAZ GLBs loaded together as one complete walkthrough world.

name: Ice Hockey Arena
label: Sports · hockey
description: Full regulation ice hockey stadium with a real ice surface, animated skaters, solo AI, live multiplayer, mixed player/AI teams and spectator views.

name: Neon Junction — Arcade Park
label: Arcade · games and rides
description: Walk through a 3D park and play hockey, shooting arcade, basketball, air hockey and billiards in their physical stations; board the perimeter train and elevated coaster. Customize 15 park assemblies and 34 reusable builder items. Shared multiplayer rounds with player slots and spectators.

name: MUZIKAZ International Airport
label: Public flight and airport experience
description: A brick-built public airport with three flyable aircraft, shared runway 18/36, taxiways, terminal, hangar, control tower, radio captions and optional spoken ATC, mobile flight controls and ground services.

dialogueSettings.text: Board with E / Use. Request Tower takeoff clearance from the radio SVG. W / left stick taxis and accelerates, A/D steer, Space or Climb rises, Shift or Descend lowers. Brake with S. Exit only after landing.

Welcome to MUZIKAZ International Airport. Explore the passenger terminal, hangar and control tower. Open the radio SVG for tower audio, runway clearance and ground services. The local map shows airport facilities and district connections.
Tower radio is available through the radio SVG. Captions always work; enable voice for spoken controller calls. One pilot at a time receives runway clearance. Airspace ceiling: 80 metres.
